RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

That number represents uncertainty, not an evidence-based estimate; these facts cannot establish a reliable probability.

An all-male panel raises a reasonable question about safeguards against bias, but does not itself show discrimination. Your PhD and eight years of leadership make you a credible candidate; they do not establish that you better met every selection criterion.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your qualifications were assessed, and how the panel ensured a fair process. Raise its composition as a procedural concern, rather than proof of bias.

Keep records. If explanations reveal inconsistent criteria or sex-based assumptions, consult your union or an employment adviser promptly; complaint deadlines vary by jurisdiction.
